blacklist_kernel_modules.description: Whether to blacklist native Razer kernel modules (e.g., razerkbd, razermouse) to avoid conflicts.

driver_support.description: Enable full driver support for Razer peripherals (required for most features like lighting, polling rate, etc.).

device_db_dir.description: Path to the directory containing device-specific quirks and configuration overrides.

usb_autosuspend.description: Enable USB autosuspend for power-saving; disable if devices behave erratically.

usb_init_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for USB device enumeration before giving up.

legacy_devices.description: Enable experimental support for legacy devices not officially supported by the latest firmware.

items.description: Name of a kernel module to explicitly load (e.g., 'razeraccessory'). Leave empty to skip.

extra_kernel_modules.description: List of additional kernel modules to load at startup beyond the default ones.

log_level.description: Verbosity of the daemon log (0=ERROR, 1=WARN, 2=INFO, 3=DEBUG). Higher levels produce more detail.

log_file.description: Path to the daemon log file. Must be writable by the daemon user.

chroma_sdk.description: Enable compatibility with Razer Chroma SDK (for third-party integrations).

synapse_compat.description: Enable compatibility with Razer Synapse 2/3 protocols for seamless driver replacement.

wake_on_usb.description: Enable wake-on-USB for supported devices (e.g., keyboards/mice waking the system from sleep).

max_devices.description: Maximum number of Razer devices the daemon will manage simultaneously.

runtime_dir.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., PID, sockets). Should be cleared on reboot.
